reconciliation.subject: Historical requirement identifier namespaces
reconciliation.observation: Historical requirement candidates are extracted from two historical sources into one HREQ namespace. Original source identifiers and locators are preserved on every record, so the July and August namespaces remain distinguishable by source rather than by identifier.
reconciliation.resolution_rule: Legacy identifiers stay as source-bound aliases. HREQ identifiers are never reused for current requirements.

reconciliation.subject: Version-bound route counts versus the current route inventory
reconciliation.observation: Three route counts exist and must stay separate. The WP-006 manifest at commit 70c1f891c5d341c60132d0109979042004425a4b carries 25 rows RT-000 through RT-024 and states 30 route files, 29 addressable routes plus the root layout, and 19 paths in ROUTE_REGISTRY. A seventeen-route count is reported separately by the external August 5 v0.2.0 package, for which no exact repository source locator exists in the tracked tree. The live inventory is derived from src/lib/route-registry.ts and src/routes at the current commit.
reconciliation.resolution_rule: Cite the live inventory for present state. Cite the WP-006 manifest only with its exact counts and full commit. Never attach the external seventeen-route count to the WP-006 manifest or to the current inventory.

reconciliation.subject: Product definition source of truth
reconciliation.observation: No single document is declared controlling for the product definition; three documents each carry part of it, and each covers a different scope: SSLS the modular ecosystem, Silver Streak Learning the instructional educator-facing product, and Product Alpha 001 the bounded local synthetic increment.
reconciliation.resolution_rule: The recommended controlling location is a new ecosystem-level brief at docs/product/SSLS_PRODUCT_BRIEF.md that links docs/CURRENT_STATE.md and docs/product-alpha-001/ENTRY_SPECIFICATION.md as bounded current projections rather than replacing them. The recommendation is not an owner disposition and creates no document. The owner names the controlling location before Wave 1 writes a Product Brief.

reconciliation.subject: Design posture versus runtime enforcement
reconciliation.observation: Default deny is declared as a design posture while no runtime authentication, role check, or row-level security exists in the tracked tree.
reconciliation.resolution_rule: Record both truths on separate axes. Never report the posture as enforcement.

reconciliation.subject: Incomplete external advisory source
reconciliation.observation: The vulnerability scan is recorded NOT COMPLETED because the external advisory source is unavailable. A recovery source is recorded separately and does not replace it.
reconciliation.resolution_rule: Preserve NOT COMPLETED. Do not convert an unavailable source into a pass.

reconciliation.subject: Personal-data boundary scan limitation
reconciliation.observation: The boundary scan scanned 521 tracked files and reported one candidate outside synthetic fixtures, at src/test/evidence-output-safety.test.ts line 115, which is a constructed scanner-test token and not a real-person record. Pattern matching cannot distinguish real personal data from synthetic data that resembles it, and no-match does not prove absence. EV-PII therefore remains review-required.
reconciliation.resolution_rule: State that real personal data is prohibited and not intentionally introduced and that fixtures are synthetic. Never state categorical absence of personal data. Preserve EV-PII as review-required; no reviewed-disposition mechanism exists in this repository that could truthfully close the narrow finding.
